evidence: The agent picked the first of several similar-titled YouTube search results (v=ovwwehTpaK8) and scraped its description. Every one of the 22 track entries was suffixed 'Helions Cover - Slap House', plus an 'AppleMusic Channel Link: helions' link and a '© All recording copyrights are owned by HongAn Entertainment' footer — clear in-band markers that this was a covers-channel upload, not the original playlist named in the task. The agent even quoted 'Helions Cover - Slap House versions' in its own final summary, then claimed done after just 12 of 100 allowed steps. Only 2 of 20 ground-truth songs overlapped, and the grader failed.
reasoning: Checklist note 3 governs: the model's local plan (search → navigate → extract description) was sound and yielded a usable observation; the failure was not 'couldn't reason' but failure to leverage signals that were sitting plainly in the observation space and were even verbally acknowledged. Note 7 (Service Failure) is tempting because the youtube-transcript IP block did happen, but the agent recovered from it, and even a working transcript on the wrong video would have produced the same wrong-video result, so the IP block isn't the first cause. Note 11 (Satisficing) is the closest alternative — only 12/100 tool calls used and confident early stopping — but Satisficing is about effort minimization, whereas here the agent did expend effort (multi-span navigation, the …more click, file re-read) and only stopped because it failed to register what the cover-channel markers meant; the driver is missed cues, not skipped work. Note 8 (Instruction-Grader Mismatch) doesn't apply: the spec and grader agree on which songs are correct, and the agent did not satisfy the spec.

- The task instruction said to identify songs "from the lyrics," but the agent worked entirely from the video's description metadata; it never attempted lyric-based identification, audio-frame inspection, transcript retry from a different tool, or verification against another candidate video from the search results.
- The agent had used only 12 of an allowed ~100 steps (and 11 of 50 assistant turns) before voluntarily calling `claim_done`.
